finding: Qwen's dedicated 2026 Qwen3-VL-Embedding family explicitly trains/uses a multimodal representation path for retrieval across text, images, screenshots and video, rather than presenting arbitrary raw base-VLM visual states as a calibrated retrieval embedding.
why_interesting_for_target_architecture: This directly challenges the strongest simplification assumption in QNDRF: raw Qwen3.5 mmproj features may be reusable physically but may still need a tiny learned projection/readout for stable familiarity/open-set geometry.
falsifier: Raw pooled Qwen3.5 features match or beat projected/dedicated representations on the frozen Frank familiarity/open-set benchmark under equal total resource cost.
